breakdown.description: project_metric only: group each bucket by this field, or 'metadata.<key>'. Not valid for every metric — schema('list.project_metric') says which.
breakdown.title: Breakdown

entity_type.description: One of: project, project_metric, span, thread, trace.
entity_type.title: Entity Type

fields.description: Return only these columns, uncut: any name from the page's 'fields:' line ('data.question', 'feedback_scores.helpfulness', 'usage.total_tokens'). Each row keeps the id that opens the next level. An unknown name is refused with the valid ones. Omit for the table's own columns.
fields.title: Fields

filters.description: OQL filter for trace, span, thread, project_metric: <field>[.<key>] <op> <value> [AND ...]; ops = != > >= < <= contains not_contains starts_with ends_with is_empty is_not_empty in not_in; strings quoted, numbers bare (duration in ms). E.g. 'error_info is_not_empty AND duration > 5000'. trace/span/thread default to source = "sdk". Reference: schema("list.trace").
filters.title: Filters

interval.description: project_metric only: bucket width. Omitted, it follows the window the way the Metrics tab does: hourly up to 3 days, daily up to 30, weekly beyond.
interval.title: Interval

metric_type.description: project_metric only: which metric to chart. Reference: schema('list.project_metric').
metric_type.title: Metric Type

name.description: Optional substring filter on the project name.
name.title: Name

search.description: Free text for trace, span, thread: matches anywhere in id, name, input, output, metadata, tags, thread_id (spans: model, provider too). Expensive on large projects; narrow with since first.
search.title: Search

series.description: project_metric only, with breakdown: which series to group — a percentile (p50/p90/p99), a score name, or a usage key.
series.title: Series

since.description: Start of the time window for trace, span, thread, project_metric: a relative span ('30m', '1h', '24h', '7d') or an ISO-8601 instant with timezone.
since.title: Since

sort.description: Sort for trace, span, thread: '<field> [asc|desc]', desc by default. E.g. 'duration desc', 'total_estimated_cost', 'usage.total_tokens'. One field only.
sort.title: Sort

until.description: End of the time window, same forms as since.
until.title: Until
